h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kohima

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kohima

items.pText: Very little flat land exists in Kohima. Schools, churches, colonies and offices in the Nagaland capital sit along ridges and slopes. A playground here usually has to be planned around a terrace or a cut in the hillside. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, near Mumbai, roughly 2,300 km away, and supplies sites across the north-east by road.

Because the distance is long, we spend more time on planning before anything is made. Send us photos of the site taken from a few angles, the measurements of the flat area you have and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment that fits a terrace and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. Installation is handled by our team or a dealer in the region.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Building a playground on a hillside site

c: On sloping ground, the play area must sit on a level, well-drained terrace with a retaining edge. Children must never run off a slide exit towards a drop, so we face slides into the site. The layout drawing shows the clear zone around each piece. Grouting into a concrete base suits most hill sites better than a self-standing installation.
Kohima is cool for much of the year and very wet from roughly May to September. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle rain and moss without rusting.

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on a sloping site in Kohima?
items.a: Yes, once you have a level terrace for the play area. We mark the safe zone on the layout drawing and usually recommend grouting the equipment into a concrete base on hill sites.

items.q: Is it practical to order from Vasai for a site in Nagaland?
items.a: It is. We send equipment across India by road and install it with our own team or a regional dealer. Good photos and accurate measurements at the start help avoid changes later.

items.q: Which pieces suit a narrow terrace?
items.a: Climbers, a single slide and spring riders take little width. A compact multi play system can also work if the terrace is deep enough for its safe play area.
